name: Always ~Futo, Ki ga Tsukeba Kimi to no Nichijou...~
original_name: Always ～ふと、気が付けばキミとの日常…～
source:
"Romantic Fool" is a new style coffee shop. Kazuya starts to work there part-time after twists and turns. There are teas, biscuits and unique and pretty waitresses. A small love romance comes into bloom...

[From ErogeShop]
